label: Estimates from a synthetic model - not measurements from a real mine.

tipping_point.rule: Smallest fleet whose mean throughput >= 95% of the plateau (mean of the 3 largest fleets tested)

interpretation: With 1 truck(s) the truck fleet limits output: 177 t/h, trucks queue 0% of the time. With 20 trucks the crusher limits output: 944 t/h (availability-adjusted bound 972 t/h, set by the crusher). The crusher is productively busy 100% and the shovel 66% of their available time; trucks spend 71% of scheduled time queuing. Throughput reaches 897 t/h (95% of the ~944 t/h plateau) at 6 trucks. Each truck beyond that adds on average 2 t/h. Once the bottleneck station is saturated, extra trucks only lengthen its queue: cycle times grow while deliveries do not.
